source.description: Where statements come from: an interview, a chat or a document, when it was, and who it came from. Its title names it; its body keeps the notes it was taken from.

from.description: Who it came from: a name or a role

statement.description: One claim from a source, as its title, tagged with what it is about: a goal, a blocker, a time sink, a handover, a tool or a rule. It names its source by path and carries the source's date, which only the intake's save sets, once someone reviewed it: an edit of its text keeps them, and a statement saved by hand, without them, is refused. Its body links the source and quotes it.

source.description: The source's record, by its path
